The *Sattamabhavikakathā* (Kv 12.10) is a canonical debate text located in the twelfth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, within the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In English scholarship, Shwe Zan Aung and C.A.F. Rhys Davids note the variant or related terminology *sattamabhavika* and *sattamaka* in their translation of the *Kathāvatthu*, *Points of Controversy* [Shwe Zan Aung & Rhys Davids 1915]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation of the text [SuttaCentral].
No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan traditions are recorded by SuttaCentral, and DharmaNexus finds no cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, DharmaNexus detects 34 internal Pali text-reuse matches across four texts, reflecting formulaic debate patterns within the collection [DharmaNexus]. The largest reuse partner is the immediately preceding *Duggatikathā* (Kv 12.9; 18 matches, including §1.2–1.7 matching §5.2–5.9), alongside further parallels within the twelfth chapter in the *Sattakkhattuparamakathā* (Kv 12.5; 7 matches) and the *Jīvitāvoropanakathā* (Kv 12.8; 6 matches), as well as 3 shared matches with the *Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi* (Tika Abh09t) [DharmaNexus].
